description: Source code for a graphics benchmarking application comparing TRIANGLE_FAN and TRIANGLES rendering methods using OpenGL ES 2.0. Implements a class 'TriangleFanBenchSample' that creates vertex buffers, initializes shaders, and measures rendering times per frame.

classes.name: TriangleFanBenchSample
classes.description: A class derived from SampleApplication that benchmarks rendering performance of triangle fans versus triangles.

methods.name: createVertexBuffers
methods.description: Creates and populates vertex buffer objects for triangle fan and triangle rendering.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up shaders, OpenGL state, and vertex buffers.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Outputs total rendering times and cleans up resources.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs rendering of the scene using both TRIANGLE_FAN and TRIANGLES, measuring time taken.
